title: the Sundered Sea Rising
author: Edmund Kavanagh
blurb: Odile Marchetti, the youngest member of a dying guild, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
